ei.subject: 수능특강 영어
ei.title: Sharing as Insurance in the Ache Tribe

fullPassage: Hunters in the Ache tribe, living in the Paraguayan jungle, have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could possibly eat; other days they come home empty-handed. If a man caught a wild pig and hoarded it for himself and his family, much of it would go to waste (there are no deep-freeze refrigerators in the Paraguayan jungle). Instead of living by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. During unlucky periods, individual hunters and their families would starve. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. In exchange for this generosity, their neighbors share with them on days when the luck runs the other way. By exchanging resources, particularly those that are unpredictable and uncertain (like meat from the hunt, as opposed to vegetable crops), the group provides a mutual insurance policy against starvation.

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe, ①<u>living</u> in the Paraguayan jungle, have a lot of ups and downs in their success at the hunt. Some days they bring home much more food than they could ②<u>possible</u> eat; other days they come home ③<u>empty-handed</u>. If a man caught a wild pig and ④<u>hoarded</u> it for himself, much of it would go to waste.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: could possibly eat. 부사 possibly가 필요 (동사 eat 수식).
det.analysis:
❌② possible → possibly: 부사 possibly(아마도)가 동사 eat을 수식
✅① living: 현재분사 (분사구문)
✅③ empty-handed: 복합형용사
✅④ hoarded: 과거시제
det.tip: possibly(부사) ≠ possible(형용사). 동사 수식에는 부사.

questions.passage: Instead of ①<u>living</u> by a philosophy of "rugged individualism," however, hunters who have a lucky day share their meat with other families. And they don't just share a little; they share a lot — fully 90%. In exchange for this generosity, their neighbors ②<u>share</u> with them on days when the luck ③<u>runs</u> the other way. By ④<u>exchange</u> resources, the group provides a mutual insurance policy against starvation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: By exchanging resources. 전치사 By 뒤에 동명사 필요.
det.analysis:
❌④ exchange → exchanging: By + 동명사 (수단/방법)
✅① living: 전치사 of + 동명사
✅② share: 복수주어 일치
✅③ runs: 3인칭 단수 일치
det.tip: By + 동명사 = ~함으로써: By exchanging(교환함으로써)

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 냉동 냉장고가 없으므로 낭비될(go to waste) 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅③ go to waste: 원문과 일치
❌① increase in value: 가치 증가 — 반대
❌② remain fresh: 신선 유지 — 냉장고 없음
❌④ be shared: 비축(hoarded)한 경우
det.tip: go to waste = 낭비되다. 냉장고 없으므로 보관 불가.

questions.passage: Hunters in the Ache tribe have ups and downs. Instead of hoarding, they share 90% of their catch. In exchange, neighbors share back when luck reverses. By exchanging unpredictable resources, the group provides a mutual insurance policy. This sharing system works because hunting success is __________ while the timing of individual luck varies.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사냥 성공은 어느 날이든 예측 불가능(unpredictable)하다.

❌① always guaranteed: 반대
❌③ equally distributed: 균등하지 않음
❌④ individual skill alone: 운도 영향
det.tip: unpredictable → 공유가 보험 역할
